meta.title: Hold a PR line item with a remark; it appears in the Hold tab with who held it

plan.title: Hold PR Line and Verify Holder

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area as the starting point for the PR flow.

args.goal: open a PR with a line item that is not on hold, scroll to the line item's Hold Item control, enter a remark explaining why it is being held, confirm Hold Item, open the PR's Hold tab, and stop when the held line and the holder's name are visible

steps.note: Performs the hold action and navigates to the Hold tab, including the remark and confirmation that no catalog step can express directly.
Assert that the Hold tab contains at least one held line item after the action.
